cases.purpose: Check the same renewal datagram is unicast with ciaddr and neither requested-address nor server-identifier options.
cases.oracle: RFC 2131 section 4.3.2 table 5: in RENEWING state the REQUEST has server identifier MUST NOT be filled in.
cases.comparison: Candidate bashdhcp in a mapped user namespace on a veth pair; an independent Python DHCPv4 peer in a second network namespace sniffs raw frames and applies RFC 2131 field checks. Reverse-path filtering is switched off in the private namespace so the address-less client can accept broadcast replies. Each assertion is one printed line; any failing line changes stdout.

files.case.sh:
IP=/usr/bin/ip
PY=/usr/bin/python3
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w2-dhcp4.py
die() { echo "SETUP-FAILED $*"; exit 90; }
/usr/bin/mount -t sysfs sysfs /sys || die sysfs
$IP link set lo up || die lo
$IP link add veth0 address 02:00:00:00:0a:01 type veth peer name veth1 address 02:00:00:00:0a:02 || die veth
echo 0 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/all/rp_filter || die rpf-all
echo 0 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/veth0/rp_filter || die rpf-veth0
exec 7<>sync.fifo
"$PY" "$H" peer full sync.fifo 2> peer.err &
peer=$!
read -t 20 -u 7 line || die peer-pid
[[ $line == "pid=$peer" ]] || die "peer-pid-$line"
$IP link set veth1 netns "$peer" || die move
read -t 20 -u 7 line || die peer-ready
[[ $line == ready ]] || die "peer-$line"
$IP addr add 192.0.2.10/24 dev veth0 || die addr
$IP link set veth0 up || die up
settle() { read -t "$1" -u 7 line; }
bashdhcp renew -i veth0 -t 1000 'ip=192.0.2.10;server_id=192.0.2.1' > out.txt 2> err.txt; rc=$?
echo "renew-rc=$rc"
settle 0.3
kill "$peer"; wait "$peer" 2>/dev/null
"$PY" "$H" verify renew
"$PY" "$H" verify renew-no-server-id

cases.stdout:
renew-rc=0
verified renew failed=0
verified renew-no-server-id failed=0
case-status=0
